sql.projectProcessStepEvent.insertEvent: insert into flow.project_process_step_event(project_process_step_id, process_step_event_id, company_event_status_type_id, created_by_id) values(:projectProcessStepId, :processStepEventId, (select initial_company_event_status_type_id from flow.process_step_event where id = :processStepEventId), :createdById)
sql.projectProcessStepEvent.get: select ppse.*, e.event_name, e.resource_custom_field_id, pse.event_id, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(availableResources))) FROM ( select * from flow.get_system_list_options(e.company_id::integer, (select company_system_list_id from flow.custom_field cf where cf.id = e.resource_custom_field_id)::integer, true, (select system_list_option_ids from flow.custom_field cf where cf.id = e.resource_custom_field_id)::integer[], ppse.resource_id::integer)) availableResources), '[]') AS "availableResources", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(psea))) FROM ( SELECT psea.id, psea.action_name as "actionName", psea.process_step_event_id as "processStepEventId", psea.company_process_step_status_type_id as "companyProcessStepStatusTypeId", psea.company_event_status_type_id as "companyEventStatusTypeId", psea.created_by_id as "createdById", psea.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", cpsst.process_step_status_type as "processStepStatusType", cest.event_status_type as "eventStatusType", psea.archived, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(psearf))) FROM ( select psearf.id, psearf.process_step_event_action_id as "processStepEventActionId", psearf.custom_field_group_assignment_id as "customFieldGroupAssignmentId", psearf.archived, cf.field_name as "fieldName", cfg.group_name as "groupName" from flow.process_step_event_action_field psearf inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on psearf.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga.id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cfga.custom_field_id = cf.id inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id where psearf.archived is false and psearf.required is true and psearf.process_step_event_action_id = psea.id) psearf), '[]') AS "requiredFields", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(psearf))) FROM ( select psearf.id, psearf.process_step_event_action_id as "processStepEventActionId", psearf.custom_field_group_assignment_id as "customFieldGroupAssignmentId", psearf.archived, cf.field_name as "fieldName", cfg.group_name as "groupName" from flow.process_step_event_action_field psearf inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on psearf.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga.id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cfga.custom_field_id = cf.id inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id where psearf.archived is false and psearf.required is false and psearf.process_step_event_action_id = psea.id) psearf), '[]') AS "optionalFields" FROM flow.process_step_event_action psea left join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on psea.company_process_step_status_type_id = cpsst.id left join flow.company_event_status_type cest on psea.company_event_status_type_id = cest.id WHERE psea.process_step_event_id = pse.id AND psea.archived is not true) psea), '[]') AS "eventActions" from flow.project_process_step_event ppse inner join flow.process_step_event pse on ppse.process_step_event_id = pse.id inner join flow.event e on pse.event_id = e.id where ppse.id = :id
sql.projectProcessStepEvent.savePpsEventDeta: update flow.project_process_step_event set resource_id = :resourceId::int, start_time = :startTime::timestamp, end_time = :endTime::timestamp, modified_by_id = :modifiedById::int, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.projectProcessStepEvent.getCompanyId: select e.company_id from flow.project_process_step_event ppse inner join flow.process_step_event pse on ppse.process_step_event_id = pse.id inner join flow.event e on pse.event_id = e.id where ppse.id = :sourceId
sql.projectProcessStepEvent.getProjectProces: select a.id, a.size, a.uuid, a.date_created, a.date_modified, a.filename, a.attachment_type_id, a.content_type, a.s3_key, a.archived, substring(filename, '\.([^\.]+)$') as file_extension, ps.process_step_name, ppsa.project_process_step_event_id, pps.id as "projectProcessStepId", pps.main, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS uploadedBy from flow.project_process_step_event_attachment ppsa inner join flow.attachment a on a.id = ppsa.attachment_id inner join flow.project_process_step_event ppse on ppse.id = ppsa.project_process_step_event_id inner join flow.project_process_step pps on pps.id = ppse.project_process_step_id inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = pps.process_step_id inner join flow."user" u ON a.created_by_id = u.id where ppsa.project_process_step_event_id = :projectProcessStepEventId and a.archived is not true order by pps.main desc, pps.date_created desc
sql.projectProcessStepEvent.updateCompanyEve: update flow.project_process_step_event set company_event_status_type_id = :companyEventStatusTypeId, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :userId where id = :projectProcessStepEventId
sql.projectProcessStepEvent.randaHacking: update flow.project_process_step set company_process_step_status_type_id = :companyProcessStepStatusTypeId, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :userId where id = :ppsId
